description: Gets all items in inventory that belong to the users company. Inventory items have a name, id, value (cost), stock, and other parameters. Quantities are decimals. When an item has a unit (e.g. "kg", "lb", "ml") every quantity on it (inventoryCount, onOrderCount, damagedCount, toShipCount) is measured in that unit; when unit is null the item is counted in discrete pieces.
name: get_inventory
